caption: The drawing consists of a repeating botanical pattern on a rectangular piece of cream or light beige paper. The design features stylized flowers, leaves, and stems rendered in varying shades of blue, ranging from light blue to dark indigo. The flowers are bulbous and round, with petals and interior detailing created through patterned shading. The leaves are large, elongated, and have serrated or scalloped edges, also filled with intricate blue patterns. Stems curve and connect the botanical elements throughout the composition. The objects are densely packed, with the background color of the paper visible between the motifs. The left side of the sheet includes a faint, narrow vertical rectangular section that appears to show part of the pattern in a lighter and less detailed form, possibly a preliminary sketch or a transferred pattern. The overall arrangement repeats the floral and leaf forms with some variation in orientation.
title: Resist Printed Linen
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
